title: Re-attempt indicator
text: The network may include this IE if the network includes the Back-off timer value IE and the 5GSM cause value is not #26 "insufficient resources", #28 "unknown PDU session type", #39 "reactivation requested", #46 "out of LADN service area", #54 "PDU session does not exist", #67 "insufficient resources for specific slice and DNN", #68 "not supported SSC mode", or #69 "insufficient resources for specific slice"
